steps.title: Select your SVG files
steps.desc: In File Explorer or on the desktop, select one SVG file or as many as you like.

steps.title: Hold Ctrl and drag
steps.desc: Hold Ctrl (or the key you set in Filee) and drag the files. A donut of formats opens at the cursor. Prefer menus? Right-click and choose Convert with Filee.

steps.title: Drop on DXF
steps.desc: Release the files over DXF. A progress ring counts up, and each DXF file is saved next to its original.

details.title: What Filee does for SVG → DXF
details.tip: Laser cutters, CNC software and CAD programs read DXF. Filee writes the SVG's outlines in millimetres, so a shape 100 mm wide stays 100 mm. Curves become fine polylines. Fills, images and filters are left out.
checks: Built in: works right after installing Filee, with nothing else to download.
No AutoCAD or DWG viewer needed.
Batch: one file or hundreds, converted in parallel; a failure never stops the rest.
Private: files are converted on your PC and never uploaded, even without internet.
Saved next to the original, or in a folder and with a file name pattern you choose.

about.name: SVG
about.desc: SVG is an XML-based vector graphics format. Shapes and text stay sharp at any size, which makes it ideal for logos and icons on the web, but many apps and upload forms only accept pixel images.

about.name: DXF
about.desc: DXF (Drawing Exchange Format) is Autodesk's interchange format for CAD drawings. Laser cutters, CNC software and most CAD programs read it, so it is the usual way to move drawings between tools.

ldJson.name: How to convert SVG to DXF on Windows
ldJson.description: Convert SVG files to DXF on Windows 10 and 11: free, offline and in batches. Drag the files onto DXF in Filee's format donut and the DXF files appear next to the originals.

step.name: Hold Ctrl and drag

step.name: Drop on DXF
step.text: Release the files over DXF. A progress ring counts up, and each DXF file is saved next to its original.

steps.title: DXF에 놓기

step.text: 탐색기나 바탕화면에서 GLB 파일을 하나 또는 여러 개 고르세요.

step.name: Ctrl 누른 채 끌기
step.text: Ctrl(또는 Filee에서 정한 키)을 누른 채 파일을 끌면 커서 위치에 형식 도넛이 열려요. 메뉴가 편하다면 우클릭 메뉴에서 바로 변환할 수도 있어요.

step.name: OBJ에 놓기
step.text: OBJ 칸 위에서 손을 떼면 진행률 링이 차오르고, OBJ 파일이 원본 옆에 저장돼요.

zh-CN.title: GLB 转 OBJ：免费离线批量转换 | Filee
zh-CN.description: 用 Filee 在 Windows 10/11 上免费把 GLB 转成 OBJ：拖放即可，支持批量转换，离线运行，文件不上传。内置功能，无需额外安装。
zh-CN.lead: 在 Windows 10 和 11 上免费把 GLB 文件转换为 OBJ，离线、批量都可以。把文件拖到格式圆环的 OBJ 上松开，OBJ 文件就会出现在原文件旁边。

steps.title: 选择 GLB 文件
steps.desc: 在资源管理器或桌面上选中一个或多个 GLB 文件。

steps.title: 按住 Ctrl 拖动
steps.desc: 按住 Ctrl（或在 Filee 中设置的键）拖动文件，光标处会弹出格式圆环。习惯用菜单的话，也可以右键点击文件直接转换。

steps.title: 放到 OBJ 上
steps.desc: 在 OBJ 上松开，进度环走完后，每个 OBJ 文件都会保存在原文件旁边。

details.title: Filee 如何处理 GLB → OBJ
details.tip: 把网页或游戏引擎中的模型导入只读 OBJ 的软件时很方便。.mtl 文件和纹理会保存在 .obj 旁边，请把它们放在一起。
checks: 内置：安装 Filee 后即可使用，无需额外下载。
目标格式支持时会保留颜色、纹理和材质。STL 只保存形状。
批量：一个或上百个文件并行转换，某个失败也不影响其他文件。
隐私：文件在你的电脑上转换，从不上传，没有网络也能用。
输出：保存在原文件旁，或保存到你指定的文件夹，并按你设定的规则命名。

about.name: GLB
about.desc: GLB 是 glTF 的单文件版本，glTF 是网页、AR 和游戏引擎常用的 3D 格式，网格、材质和纹理都打包在一个紧凑的文件里。
about.moreText: 查看全部 3D 模型格式

about.name: OBJ
about.desc: OBJ（Wavefront）是几乎所有 3D 软件都能打开的纯文本 3D 格式，材质和纹理另存在旁边的 .mtl 文件和图片中。
about.moreText: 查看全部 3D 模型格式

ldJson.name: 如何在 Windows 上把 GLB 转换为 OBJ
ldJson.description: 在 Windows 10 和 11 上免费把 GLB 文件转换为 OBJ，离线、批量都可以。把文件拖到格式圆环的 OBJ 上松开，OBJ 文件就会出现在原文件旁边。

step.name: 选择 GLB 文件
step.text: 在资源管理器或桌面上选中一个或多个 GLB 文件。

step.name: 按住 Ctrl 拖动
step.text: 按住 Ctrl（或在 Filee 中设置的键）拖动文件，光标处会弹出格式圆环。习惯用菜单的话，也可以右键点击文件直接转换。

step.name: 放到 OBJ 上
step.text: 在 OBJ 上松开，进度环走完后，每个 OBJ 文件都会保存在原文件旁边。
